mu_name_from: MuMain ZzzInventory.cpp:1693, `case 2: I18N::Game::Firecracker` -- MU's Box of Luck (14, 11, ITEM_BOX_OF_LUCK) at level 2, drawn as MODEL_EVENT + 5 (ZzzObject.cpp:6058-6066), which ZzzOpenData.cpp:981 loads from Data\Item\MagicBox03.bmd.
why_this_one:
The user, 2026-10-02: "i like idea of the firecrarcker, but only from dungeons", then "lets implement it with all the mechanincs, but drops only from dungeons liek dungeon,lost-tower,bc,and devil aquare iin future". MU keys every one of its boxes off 14, 11 by level (docs/drop-boxes.md); this tree gives the Firecracker its own row at MU's group and number, since nothing else here is a 14, 11 yet. invention: the row per box rather than per level.

It does not drop from monsters by the ordinary draw: where it falls is its own roll (sim/items.h), so the flag is off and Realm::leave's pools never meet it.
profile_note: As the Ale: a small painted sheet on a made object seen close.
tells: Throw it and you may receive some Zen or items.
tells_from: MU's own tooltip for its boxes (docs/kundun-box-sources.md section 4.2): "Throw it and you may receive some Zen or items".

stats.note: Group and number are MU's ITEM_BOX_OF_LUCK; one cell, as MU's box, and one use.

sheet_from: Data/Item/firecracker.OZJ (32x32) from MuMain's own bin/Data, which MagicBox03.bmd names firecracker.jpg on all 24 triangles: a red paper tube with gold bands and the character 福 (fortune) on it -- a New Year cracker.
material_note: Paper wrapped round a charge: cloth, the library's rough dielectric. The gold bands are paint on the paper.
upright_from: MU stands MODEL_EVENT + 5 up by `Angle[0] = 90` (ZzzObject.cpp:5729) on the ground; as authored here.
